name: gateforge
description: Converts recognized source artifacts into explicit, machine-verifiable test obligations.

scripts.license:sync: for p in packages/*/; do cp LICENSE "$p"; done
scripts.publish:all: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run license:sync && npm publish --workspaces
scripts.pack:check: npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run license:sync && npm pack --dry-run --workspaces
